div.head: Af El. 34
div.ab: Ða wydewan ⁊ þa steopcyld ne scyþþað, ⁊ ne hy nawer deriað. Gif ge þonne elles doð, hy clipiað to me, ⁊ ic gehire hy ⁊ ic eow ðonne slea mid minum sweorde and ic eow gedó, þæt eowre wif beoð wudewan ⁊ eowre bearn steopcyld.

Þa wuduwan ⁊ þa stiopcild ne sceððað ge, ne hie nawer deriað. Gif ge þonne elles doð, hie cleopiað to me, ⁊ ic gehiere hie ⁊ ic eow þonne slea mid minum sweorde ⁊ ic gedó, þæt eowru wíf beoð wydewan ⁊ eowru bearn beoð steopcild.

Uiduæ et pupillo non nocebitis. Si leseritis eos, uociferabuntur ad me, et ego exaudiam clamorem eorum, et indignabitur furor meus, percutiamque uos gladio, et erunt uxores uestræ uiduæ et filii uestri pupilli.

Þa wuduwan ⁊ þa stiopcild ne sceððað ge, ne hie nawer deriað. Gif ge þonne elles doð, hie cleopiað to me, ⁊ ic gehiere hie ⁊ ic eow þonne slea mid minum sweorde ⁊ ic gedó, þæt eowru wif beoð wydewan ⁊ eowru bearn beoð steopcild.

Widows and orphans you will not harm, nor will you ever hurt them. If you do otherwise, they will cry out to me, and I will hear them and I will then strike you with my sword; and I will arrange that your wives will be widows and your children will be orphans.

Die Wittwen und die Waisen schädiget nicht, noch beeinträchtiget sie irgendwo. Wenn ihr jedoch anders handelt, so werden sie zu mir rufen, und ich erhöre sie und alsdann schlag ich euch mit meinem Schwerte und ich mache, dass eure Weiber Wittwen werden und eure Kinder Waisen werden.

Do not harm the widows and the orphans, nor wrong them anywhere. But if you act otherwise, they will cry to me, and I will hear them, and then I will strike you with my sword and I will make your wives become widows and your children become orphans.
